scope: Exact owned-child cleanup ordering plus removal of the two native-harness setuid ps census producers; no browser/build/SDK or permission changes.

cleanup.change: Poll the exact Popen child before group probes. A permission error permits one fresh group probe only after poll newly reaps that exact child. Live, already-reaped and still-denied residual groups remain unavailable/error. No signal target selection changes.
cleanup.requiredMacEvidence: Pipe-gated exact live child -> WNOWAIT exit-pending -> same-birth BSD zombie; kill(pid,0) succeeds, raw group-probe EPERM; exact Popen reap -> group-probe ESRCH. No signals in this experiment.

nativeHarness.api: Read-only libproc PROC_UID_ONLY list, full BSD136 arg1, proc_pidpath, sysctl KERN_PROCARGS2. UID-only discovery does not alter all-member resource sampling.
nativeHarness.identity: PID/full birth/effective UID/path/exact argv tuple snapshot consistency, ambiguity/profile checks and per-signal rechecks retained. Two argv snapshots and path/BSD rechecks cannot make exec atomic.
nativeHarness.unavailable: Zero/errno/short/saturated/truncated inventory or argv, UID/birth/path/argv conflict, and permission denial fail closed. A read failure may be skipped only after fresh authoritative BSD/ESRCH proves absence. No EINVAL=>gone shortcut.
nativeHarness.binding: Existing startup patch now binds both modified harness files. Helper absent target/source hash/copy hash verified. Mac preflight uses identical prepare_harness and checks all prepared bytes.

monitorCorrectness.threeEPERM: Known owned ps lifetime can legitimately deny counters; that alone establishes no product failure. Live unknown counters still cannot satisfy the existing resource contract.
monitorCorrectness.expectedExit: An exact exited stage retains existing break/wait/cleanup handling; owned zombie cleanup is reaped before interpreting group state.
monitorCorrectness.remainingLiveDenial: Still abort/inconclusive, with RSS/CPU null, unchanged resource limits/retry count/spacing and no role exclusion.
monitorCorrectness.nativePath: Avoid creating the privileged census descendants instead of pretending they used zero resources.
monitorCorrectness.report: Explicit validationOutcome execution=monitor-inconclusive and nativeAuthentication=not-verified unless actual native summary passed. Overall status and final proof gates unchanged.

tests.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONWARNINGS=error::ResourceWarning python -m unittest test_owned_cleanup test_native_processes test_ps_lifetime test_guards -q

plannedMacJob: One standard public macos-15-intel job, all97 tests plus existing controlled ps lifetime and newly prepared real-harness census; no upload/SDK/build/security changes.
limitations: Real Mac APIs and cleanup ordering not yet executed for this patch
No native browser/Shim authentication in an SDK-free gate
Historical denied generation and native exit cause remain unknown
